title: 第五章   诸葛逍遥
content_zh:
咻！咻！一阵风划破寂静的山间，仔细一看一道人影飞快的往山顶而去，不一会儿，人影来到了山顶之上。

    每天清晨，少年都会准时来到这里修炼，日复一日，无论刮风下雨，还是烈日炙烤，又或者是风雪侵蚀，少年都不会间断。

    “呵～呼！”少年又开始了一天的修炼征程，看着少年的起步姿势出拳方式以及出拳速度，这活生生的就是太极拳法在这个世界重现！太极拳热身结束后，少年在他的手臂以及脚腕处，绑着沉甸甸的铁块做起了深蹲，仰卧起坐，以及俯卧撑等各种强健体魄的运动高强度的运动，使得少年的肌肉随着身体的律动而一起运动起来汗水从衣服中不停的渗出，就连铁块也是浸满了少年的汗水，在阳光的照射下，黑色的铁块散发出点点晶光，仿佛布满了晶莹的水晶。汗水进入了他的眼睛里，那种酸涩的感觉使得少年紧咬着牙关。即便如此他也不能结束训练，因为训练的难度还没有足够，所以他必须要坚持，他随即背起大石在山顶之上奔跑跳跃着，一个时辰之后，他可以明显的感觉到高强度的训练使得浑身肌肉所散发出来的那种酸麻与疲惫，通常很多人在这个时候，都是会选择休息，对于少年来说这更是不能休息的时候，因为恰恰在这种时候，方才能够突破身体的极限，所以…他…一定要坚持！

    绝不能放松！为了查明家族覆灭的原因，他不能懈怠，只有获得更强的实力才有机会查明原因！没有任何资源的提供，要在修炼速度赶上那些所谓的天才，他必须要拼命的修炼！

    突破极限的训练，往往使得少年头晕目眩，但这种训练使得少年的体质比同龄人高处很多个档次。结束训练后，少年平静的站在山巅上休息着。

    “十四年了呢，我来到这里也有十四年了啊！时间过得好快……”

    在少年的心里，一个只有他自己知道的秘密：他并不是这个世界的人，或者说，他的灵魂，并不属于这个世界，他来自一个名叫地球的蔚蓝星球，他只知道他叫王琼，是一名在校大学生，他依稀记得他是在一场无法比拟的灾难中失去了生命，至于怎么来到了这个世界，他也解释不清楚。总之他穿越了……

    少年回想着来到这世界的点点滴滴：那个狂风暴雨的夜晚，他一出生就得知自己的父亲以及两位叔叔战死，看到的是一个女人无助的眼神，以及一个老人毅然决然的目光，那个女人就是他今生的母亲，他亲眼看着自己的母亲离开人世，随后老人也命仆人把他带离诸葛家？然而就在那个夜晚，他所出生的家族消失了！

    “十四年了，不知道还有多少人记得诸葛一族啊？是否还记得诸葛一族的付出！是否还记得那个风雨交加的夜晚！是否记得那个人间惨剧！”少年远眺着外面的世界喃喃着。

    “想我王琼今世重生，居然是无父无母的孤儿！如此人间惨剧居然是我的亲身经历！亲眼目睹着今生的亲人一个个离去，而我却无能为力！我恨啊！”

    爷爷！父亲！母亲！叔叔！我在这里发誓，我一定会查明真相，还你们一个公道！少年冲着天空咆哮着。

    “哎哟！逍遥修炼结束没有啊，赶紧回去吃饭了，每天都跑上山来找你，都快把我这老骨头累垮了！”老人气喘吁吁的说道。
content_en:
call out! call out! A gust of wind pierced the silent mountain. If you look closely, you can see a figure quickly heading towards the top of the mountain. After a while, the figure arrived at the top of the mountain.

    Every morning, the young man would come here on time to practice. Day after day, no matter it was windy or rainy, scorching sun, or eroded by wind and snow, the young man would not stop.

    "Hoo!" The young man started another day of training. Looking at the young man's starting position and punching speed, he saw that Tai Chi was reappearing in this world! After the Tai Chi warm-up, the boy tied heavy iron blocks to his arms and ankles and did squats, sit-ups, push-ups and other physical strengthening exercises. The high-intensity exercises made the boy's muscles follow suit. Sweat kept seeping out from his clothes as he moved along with the rhythm of his body. Even the iron block was soaked with the boy's sweat. Under the sunlight, the black iron block emitted little bits of crystal light, as if it were covered with crystal clear crystals. Sweat entered his eyes, and the sour feeling made the boy clench his teeth. Even so, he could not end the training, because the training was not difficult enough, so he had to persist. He immediately picked up the big stone and ran and jumped on the top of the mountain. An hour later, he could clearly feel the tingling and fatigue from the muscles all over the body caused by the high-intensity training. Usually many people would choose to rest at this time, and for teenagers, this is a time when they cannot rest, because it is at this time that they can break through the limits of the body, so... he... must persist!

    Never relax! In order to find out the reason for the destruction of his family, he cannot slack off. Only by gaining stronger strength can he have a chance to find out the reason! Without the provision of any resources, if he wants to catch up with those so-called geniuses in terms of cultivation speed, he must practice desperately!

    Limit-breaking training often makes young people dizzy, but this kind of training makes young people's physiques much higher than those of their peers. After the training, the boy stood calmly on the top of the mountain and rested.

    "It's been fourteen years. It's been fourteen years since I came here! Time flies so fast..."

    In the young man's heart, there is a secret that only he knows: he is not from this world, or in other words, his soul does not belong to this world. He comes from a blue planet called Earth. He only knows that his name is Wang Qiong and that he is a college student. He vaguely remembers that he lost his life in an incomparable disaster. As for how he came to this world, he cannot explain clearly. Anyway, he traveled through time...

    The young man recalled every detail of his arrival in this world: that stormy night, when he was born, he learned that his father and two uncles had died in battle. What he saw were the helpless eyes of a woman and the resolute eyes of an old man. That woman was his mother in this life. He watched his mother pass away with his own eyes. Then the old man ordered his servants to take him away from the Zhuge family? However, that night, the family he was born into disappeared!

    "Fourteen years have passed. I wonder how many people still remember the Zhuge clan? Do you still remember the sacrifices of the Zhuge clan? Do you still remember that stormy night? Do you remember that human tragedy?" The young man murmured, looking at the world outside.

    "I thought that I, Wang Qiong, would be reborn in this life and be an orphan without a father or a mother! Such a human tragedy is actually my personal experience! I have witnessed my relatives in this life leave one by one, but I can't do anything about it! I hate it!"

    Grandpa! Father! Mother! uncle! I swear here that I will find out the truth and give you justice! The boy roared at the sky.

    "Ouch! Is Xiaoyao's practice over? Hurry up and go back to eat. I run up the mountain to find you every day. My old bones are almost exhausted!" The old man said panting.
